record.summary: Limits the use of artificial intelligence in therapy and psychotherapy services. It prohibits anyone from using AI to provide mental health care and therapeutic decision-making, while allowing licensed behavioural health professionals to use AI for administrative and supplementary support services. Its stated aims are to protect patients from unregulated and unqualified AI products and to protect children amid concerns over AI chatbot use in youth mental health services. The Department of Financial and Professional Regulation may investigate suspected violations, and each confirmed violation carries a fine of up to $10,000.
record.notes: Signed by Governor Pritzker on Friday 1 Aug 2025 and announced by the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) on 4 Aug 2025; it took effect on signature. The Act passed both chambers of the General Assembly unanimously and was developed with IDFPR and the National Association of Social Workers, Illinois Chapter.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: re-read the IDFPR press release of 4 Aug 2025 (idfpr.illinois.gov PDF, stored 11 Oct 2026), the only stored source. summary.quote: The Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources Act prohibits anyone from using AI to provide mental health and therapeutic decision-making, while allowing the use of AI for administrative and supplementary support services for licensed behavioral health professionals.
This will protect patients from unregulated and unqualified AI products, while also protecting the jobs of Illinois’ thousands of qualified behavioral health providers.
This will also protect vulnerable children amid the rising concerns over AI chatbot use in youth mental health services.
IDFPR will have the authority to investigate all suspected violations of the Act. All confirmed violations will result in a fine of up to $10,000 to IDFPR.

notes.quote: For Immediate Release: Contact: Chris Slaby August 4, 2025
Governor JB Pritzker signed legislation on Friday that protects patients by limiting the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in therapy and psychotherapy services.
Act was unanimously passed in each chamber of the Illinois General Assembly and goes into effect immediately with Governor Pritzker’s signature.

This Act is the result of productive collaboration between the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) , lawmakers in the Illinois General Assembly, and the National Association of Social Workers, Illinois Chapter (NASW-IL)
